title: Plane carrying Maury Island slag explodes, killing two officers

tellings.quote: >> So, they get back on their plane and they're going to fly back to their base. Their plane explodes in midair.

plain: In 1947, in Washington State, two military officers are said to have collected slag, a rough metal residue, linked to a reported incident at Maury Island. They got back on their plane to fly to their base, and the plane exploded in midair, killing them both. The researcher Peter Levenda tells this without naming a source, in a story tied to a man named Fred Crisman, and it is told because it suggests that the material, or the people carrying it, mattered to someone.
